name: Devouring Mantle
description: Wear a mantle of hollow dark from the core that eats the force of whatever strikes it.

name: Umbral Cataract
description: Pour a cataract of umbra from above that pins and batters every foe beneath it.

name: Glow Thief
description: Steal the glow of qi from a whole rank of foes until their techniques gutter out.

name: Eclipsing Palm
description: Bring down a palm that carries a small eclipse and breaks whatever it falls on.

name: Lightless Passage
description: Pass through any lightless place and step out of the next one across the whole field.

name: Great Maw
description: Hold a field that is one great mouth and drinks the force and light of every strike.

name: Silent Rend
description: Tear at a foe with a dark no shield or guard has any hold on.

name: Pitch Binding
description: Bind a foe's whole body and qi in pitch-dark cords drawn through the field.

name: Ebon Decree
description: Speak a decree of ebon dark that holds a foe and strikes him down in a single act.

name: Eclipse Crown
description: Wear a crown of eclipse that shields the user from every blow and swells the strength of each stroke.

name: Unlit Verdict
description: Pass an unlit verdict through the foe's guard and into the root of his strength.

name: Ceaseless Eclipse
description: Hold an eclipse over the field without a break to the destructive ceiling of the caster's tier.

name: Unmade Light
description: Return a stretch of ground to the dark before any light was made so that nothing in it can be lit again.
